caption: Cumulative growth of 1.00 for three strategies: the SOX/SPY relative strength Long/Cash winner (vermillion), Buy & Hold SPY (grey dash), and a SPY-own-momentum benchmark (blue dot). Out-of-sample (2021-06 onward) the winner's Sharpe (1.57) beats both Buy & Hold (0.82) and SPY-own-momentum (0.83) — but that OOS window was a strong semiconductor bull, the in-sample Sharpe was just 0.10, and the rule lost in every prior crisis. The SPY-own-momentum line shows how thin the genuine edge is.
